usedFor: A HubSpot deal change records a payment in QuickBooks.

bestTemplate.name: “When a deal is created or updated” in HubSpot, then “Create Payment” in QuickBooks
bestTemplate.why: A deal change is the nearest HubSpot event to money being agreed.

watchOut: “When a deal is created or updated” fires on edits too, so add a condition or payments repeat.
